# assets.la.io

> The LA.IO (Louisiana Innovation) brand system, served as public URLs with open CORS.
> Fetch what you need. Every file is current and permanent.

If you are an AI assistant asked to produce LA.IO work, read CLAUDE.md first. It carries
the voice rules, banned language, color families, type rules, and asset URLs. It is short.

## Start here

- [claude/CLAUDE.md](https://assets.la.io/claude/CLAUDE.md): Drop-in brand instructions. Read this before generating anything.

## Depth

- [claude/laio-brand/BRAND.md](https://assets.la.io/claude/laio-brand/BRAND.md): The full brand system.
- [claude/laio-brand/COMPONENTS.md](https://assets.la.io/claude/laio-brand/COMPONENTS.md): Component patterns as code.
- [claude/laio-brand.zip](https://assets.la.io/claude/laio-brand.zip): The whole kit packaged as a Claude skill.

## Color

- [colors/laio-tokens.json](https://assets.la.io/colors/laio-tokens.json): All five color families as JSON. Hex, RGB, brand names.
- [colors/laio-colors.css](https://assets.la.io/colors/laio-colors.css): The same values as CSS custom properties.

## Type

Aktiv Grotesk, self-hosted woff2. Light (300) or Bold (700) for headlines, Regular (400) for body.

- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Th.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Th.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Thin, weight 100.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_ThIt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_ThIt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Thin Italic, weight 100.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Lt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Lt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Light, weight 300.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_LtIt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_LtIt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Light Italic, weight 300.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Rg.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Rg.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Regular, weight 400.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_It.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_It.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Italic, weight 400.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_SBd.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_SBd.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Semibold, weight 600.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_Bd.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_Bd.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Bold, weight 700.
- [fonts/AktivGrotesk_BdIt.woff2](https://assets.la.io/fonts/AktivGrotesk_BdIt.woff2): Aktiv Grotesk Bold Italic, weight 700.

JetBrains Mono for eyebrows, labels, and metadata only. Always caps. Load from Google Fonts:
https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap

## Logos

All artwork ships black (#231F20) on transparent. Recolor with CSS. Do not edit the artwork.

- [logos/LAIO-COMPLETE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LAIO-COMPLETE.svg): Primary mark. Use this unless there is a reason not to.
- [logos/LAIO-BASE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LAIO-BASE.svg): The LA.IO mark alone.
- [logos/LAIO-HORZ.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LAIO-HORZ.svg): For wide spaces and headers.
- [logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-A.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-A.svg): Full name lockup, stacked.
- [logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-B.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/LOUISIANA-INNOVATION-B.svg): Full name lockup, condensed.
- [logos/DIVISION-LINE.svg](https://assets.la.io/logos/DIVISION-LINE.svg): The LED division line. Sits under the mark.

## Pages

- [ai](https://assets.la.io/ai): Human-readable version of this file, with previews and copy buttons.
- [claude](https://assets.la.io/claude): Setup steps for Claude projects and Claude Code.
- [labs](https://assets.la.io/labs): Louisiana Innovation Labs sub-brand identity assets.
- [illustrator](https://assets.la.io/illustrator): Generates original illustration in the LA.IO system.

## Rules that apply to all LA.IO work

- Bullets are always `+`. Never a bullet character, hyphen, or asterisk.
- Never use em dashes.
- Never write "resilient", "Silicon Bayou", or "it's not X, it's Y".
- One color family per project. Do not mix families.
- Border radius is 0 on structural elements.
